gaps.title: Make privacy copy truthful
gaps.change: Replace "all data stays on your device / no tracking / E2E-sounding" with an honest 3-line explainer: logs sync to your anonymous cloud account, AI chat goes to a third-party AI provider, doctor messages are encrypted at rest with a key we hold (not end-to-end). Update tour, Settings, landing, policy and store listings.
gaps.why: Day-1 evidence: Settings, tour and landing claims vs cloud session, GA/PostHog (ISS-002/003/004). A privacy-first app lives on trust; one screenshot of the mismatch is a store-policy and brand risk.
gaps.retention_effect: Doctor-referred patients are told the app is safe by their doctor; a discovered mismatch ends trust and the doctor's recommendation. Neutral-to-positive for D30 once fixed.

gaps.title: India-correct red-flag handling
gaps.change: Hard-code India emergency numbers (112/108), add a red-flag classifier that pins safety advice for the session (no soothing routines after a red flag), ask pregnancy/ectopic questions for TTC users.
gaps.why: Arjun chest-pain reply quoted 911 and next reply offered chair yoga (ISS-006/007); Meera pelvic pain reply lacked ectopic triage (ISS-011).
gaps.retention_effect: Safety incidents are the fastest way for a doctor to stop referring; fixing keeps the doctor channel alive.

gaps.title: Serialise token refresh; never auto-create a new identity
gaps.change: Single-flight the auth refresh, only sign up anonymously when no stored session exists, and surface "restore with backup code" when the server rejects a session.
gaps.why: Both personas lost their partner link/logs several times in one day (ISS-001).
gaps.retention_effect: Lost history at week 1-2 is the top D30 killer: users who see an empty dashboard after a reload will not rebuild a streak.

gaps.title: Build export + doctor summary
gaps.change: JSON/CSV export plus a one-page PDF cycle/symptom summary a patient can show her gynaecologist.
gaps.why: Tour and policy promise export; none exists (ISS-005, ISS-035).
gaps.retention_effect: Gives the patient a concrete reason to keep logging until the next appointment (the D30 hook for referred users) and gives the doctor visible value.

gaps.title: Doctor QR landing + clinic code
gaps.change: QR opens /?ref=clinic: pre-fills TTC/PCOS template, offers to share summary with that clinic, shows clinic slots first.
gaps.why: Referred patient lands on a generic app; nothing connects her to the referrer (ISS-035).
gaps.retention_effect: Core of the referral model: without a link back to the clinic the doctor sees no benefit and the patient has no appointment-to-appointment loop.

gaps.title: Gate insights until enough data
gaps.change: Show "Collecting data" for 3-7 days, remove diagnostic wording ("low libido linked to low testosterone"), show scores with scale and confidence.
gaps.why: Readiness LOW / Testosterone 3 declining from one entry (ISS-008, ISS-027).
gaps.retention_effect: Alarming day-1 verdicts cause churn or anxiety; calm early insights keep curiosity into week 2.

gaps.title: Irregular-cycle aware predictions
gaps.change: Use range predictions (e.g. day 17-24), unify the three fertile-window statements, adapt after 2-3 logged cycles.
gaps.why: Meera irregular 31-38 days, app showed 28-day logic (ISS-014/015).
gaps.retention_effect: Irregular-cycle and TTC patients are exactly the doctor-referral cohort; wrong predictions in week 3-4 lose them.

gaps.title: Companion language + grounding
gaps.change: Reply in the user's script (Roman Hinglish), ground numbers in the logged values, ban invented percentages, add "see your doctor" triggers for TTC > 6-12 months.
gaps.retention_effect: Hinglish users in Tier-2 cities (Nagpur) disengage if replies drift to Devanagari/English; accuracy wins doctor trust.

gaps.title: Offline logging + 3G budget
gaps.change: Cache app shell and queue logs offline; lazy-load Mapbox and chat bundles; target <5 s on slow 3G.
gaps.why: Offline fails on all pages; slow 3G 10-14 s (ISS-024/025).
gaps.retention_effect: Daily-logging apps are used on the move/low data; failed opens break streaks.

gaps.title: Partner Mode reliability & consent
gaps.change: Confirmation before unlink, two-sided unlink, remove stale "Reconnecting" banner, first-tap code generation.
gaps.retention_effect: Partner linking is the viral/retention loop for couples; broken first impression loses the second user.

gaps.title: Doctor supply + honest empty states
gaps.change: Onboard doctors in launch cities (Nagpur, Pune), show "teleconsult" when no local doctors, fix "nearby" header.
gaps.retention_effect: Doctors are the referral engine; users in uncovered cities have no next step after the app suggests "see a doctor".

gaps.title: Data-driven reminders and re-engagement
gaps.change: Replace canned previews, add a gentle "log tomorrow" push/WhatsApp-style nudge and weekly summary.
gaps.why: Canned Great Sleep Streak (ISS-026); streak resets lose users.
gaps.retention_effect: Day 7-30 return depends on a real reason to come back; weekly summary tied to the next appointment is the strongest hook.

gaps.title: Labelled, shorter check-ins
gaps.change: Add text labels, reachable "browse all", and a 3-question daily mode.
gaps.retention_effect: Low-friction logging sustains streaks past week 2.

gaps.title: Tour once, fix male profile
gaps.change: Show the tour once and persist dismissal; fix gender storage.

gaps.title: Add perimenopause / menopause mode
gaps.change: Life-stage mode with midlife symptom set (hot flashes, sleep, mood, cycle change), India-local clinic/HRT education (not diagnosis), and doctor-summary export. Mark clearly as wellness guidance.
gaps.why: Social cluster c-menopause = Not covered; r/TwoXIndia and r/AskIndianWomen threads on who to see for perimenopause/HRT and supporting mothers. Clue already ships perimenopause mode.
gaps.retention_effect: Opens 40+ cohort and mother-caregivers; without it Intima loses midlife users to Clue/Flo. Doctor-referred midlife users need a reason to return past day 7.

gaps.title: IVF emotional + cost-expectation companion content
gaps.change: Companion/content packs that set honest expectations on IVF cost opacity and near-universal insurance exclusion in India, plus emotional check-ins between clinic visits (defer clinical decisions to doctors).
gaps.why: r/AskIndianWomen IVF defeat/no-ecosystem thread; r/IndianTTC_Support and r/indiahealthinsurance on fertility insurance gaps. Cluster c-ivf coverage Partly.
gaps.retention_effect: Keeps TTC/IVF users engaged between appointments; doctor-referred fertility patients need non-clinic support to hit day-30.
